citations.statement: A reference-list entry, continued on line 376. It supports the whole roadmap on five topics: semisimple rings, the Jacobson radical, the (Jacobson–Chevalley) density theorem, the Wedderburn–Artin theorem, and an introduction to Brauer groups. These are the topics of Layers 0–3 and the entry to Layer 6. The layers carry their own pins to Mathlib; this line is the general textbook reference behind them.

register.title: Pete L. Clark, Noncommutative Algebra (lecture notes, 2012)
register.note: The author's own lecture notes, 81 pages with proofs, posted by him in his directory at the University of Georgia (alpha.math.uga.edu/~pete/) among his expository notes. They cover semisimple rings and Wedderburn–Artin, radicals, central simple algebras and the Brauer group, quaternion algebras, splitting fields, reduced norms and cyclic algebras. They do not cover the density theorem. The host did not answer on 28 September 2026; the Internet Archive holds captures of the same URL (for example 20241118181457). The title is the same as Farb–Dennis's GTM 144, whose register pattern is \*Noncommutative\ Algebra\*, so cite these notes as 'Clark, *Noncommutative algebra*'.
